title: Fodoore Haalaaɗo Dow Embers
intro: Aɗa darii sara yiite jeereende nde ƴiye mum njaltata e hakkille. Yillotooɓe ina ngara ngam hawritde e nder deeƴre, e nulal gootal ina uddita daartol fodoore, haayre, e ko arata yeeso ko timmaani tawo.
clues: Min tacci laawol ngol haa min njottii maccuɗo koolaaɗo e nder jeereende.
Min ñaagii yo ƴiye njaltinee ngam feewnude yiite.
Min kaaldi e gooto nodduɗo lewru ngam coofgol e kisal.
Min ngaddi kabaaru jibinaaɗo keso e neɗɗo mo duuɓi mum njahrata e jibinde.
Min ngaddi Ibraahiima kabaaru belɗo ɓiɗɗo gorko, kabaaru kaawningol ngol acci Ibraahiima ina jalee.
